    30	/-- A scalar-extension face diagram together with the canonical comparison square for its
    31	lower transition.  All four algebra carriers and their instances are parameters of one
    32	structure, so projections never resynthesize tensor-product metadata. -/
    33	structure ScalarExtensionFacePackage
    34	    {F K A B D E : Type u}
    35	    [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
    36	    [CommRing A] [Algebra F A] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    37	    [CommRing D] [Algebra F D] [CommRing E] [Algebra F E]
    38	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext F K) where
    39	  thetaN : N.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E
    40	  tauN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] D
    41	  tauK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] D
    42	  rightN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] B
    43	  leftN : N.1 ⊗[F] D →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E
    44	  sourceComparison : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] A
    45	  targetComparison : N.1 ⊗[F] D →ₐ[F] K ⊗[F] D
    46	  tau_square :
    47	    targetComparison.comp (tauN.restrictScalars F) =
    48	      (tauK.restrictScalars F).comp sourceComparison
    49	  face : thetaN.comp rightN = leftN.comp tauN

    51	/-- Package a commutative scalar-extension face diagram.  Every finite and ambient map is
    52	supplied as an already elaborated term, so the package never reconstructs the dependent
    53	tensor-product metadata hidden in those maps. -/
    54	noncomputable def scalarExtensionFacePackage
    55	    {F K A B D E : Type u}
    56	    [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K]
    57	    [CommRing A] [Algebra F A] [CommRing B] [Algebra F B]
    58	    [CommRing D] [Algebra F D] [CommRing E] [Algebra F E]
    59	    (N : DatG0.FinSubext F K)
    60	    (rightN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] B)
    61	    (thetaN : N.1 ⊗[F] B →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E)
    62	    (tauN : N.1 ⊗[F] A →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] D)
    63	    (leftN : N.1 ⊗[F] D →ₐ[N.1] N.1 ⊗[F] E)
    64	    (rightK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] B)
    65	    (thetaK : K ⊗[F] B →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] E)
    66	    (tauK : K ⊗[F] A →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] D)
    67	    (leftK : K ⊗[F] D →ₐ[K] K ⊗[F] E)
    68	    (hright :
    69	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)).comp
    70	          (rightN.restrictScalars F) =
    71	        (rightK.restrictScalars F).comp
    72	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)))
    73	    (htheta :
    74	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F E)).comp
    75	          (thetaN.restrictScalars F) =
    76	        (thetaK.restrictScalars F).comp
    77	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F B)))
    78	    (htau :
    79	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)).comp
    80	          (tauN.restrictScalars F) =
    81	        (tauK.restrictScalars F).comp
    82	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)))
    83	    (hleft :
    84	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F E)).comp
    85	          (leftN.restrictScalars F) =
    86	        (leftK.restrictScalars F).comp
    87	          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)))
    88	    (hfaceK : thetaK.comp rightK = leftK.comp tauK) :
    89	    ScalarExtensionFacePackage (A := A) (B := B) (D := D) (E := E) N := by
    90	  let sourceComparison :=
    91	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F A)
    92	  let targetComparison :=
    93	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F D)
    94	  let faceTargetComparison :=
    95	    Algebra.TensorProduct.map N.1.val (AlgHom.id F E)
    96	  have hcomposite :
    97	      faceTargetComparison.comp ((leftN.comp tauN).restrictScalars F) =
    98	        ((leftK.comp tauK).restrictScalars F).comp
    99	          sourceComparison := by
   100	    apply DFunLike.ext _ _
   101	    intro x
   102	    calc
   103	      faceTargetComparison ((leftN.comp tauN) x) =
   104	          leftK (targetComparison (tauN x)) :=
   105	        DFunLike.congr_fun hleft (tauN x)
   106	      _ = leftK (tauK (sourceComparison x)) := by
   107	        exact congrArg leftK (DFunLike.congr_fun htau x)
   108	      _ = ((leftK.comp tauK).restrictScalars F).comp
   109	            sourceComparison x := rfl
   110	  have hface : thetaN.comp rightN = leftN.comp tauN := by
   111	    apply DatG0.tensorProduct_algHom_comp_eq_of_baseChange N
   112	      rightN thetaN (leftN.comp tauN)
   113	      rightK thetaK (leftK.comp tauK)
   114	    · exact hright
   115	    · exact htheta
   116	    · exact hcomposite
   117	    · exact hfaceK
   118	  exact {
   119	    thetaN := thetaN
   120	    tauN := tauN
   121	    tauK := tauK
   122	    rightN := rightN
   123	    leftN := leftN
   124	    sourceComparison := sourceComparison
   125	    targetComparison := targetComparison
   126	    tau_square := htau
   127	    face := hface
   128	  }

/-!
# Affine intersections in the finite-stage Picard atlas

The exact separably closed `Pic^0` representer is a group scheme over a field, hence is
separated.  Consequently the intersection of any two affine charts in its chosen finite
atlas is itself affine.  The canonical affine overlap packaged here is the geometric input
for spreading out the finite atlas's restriction maps and gluing data.

     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Gluing
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Pullbacks
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Gluing affine schemes from ring maps
    11	
    12	This file packages affine ring data into `Scheme.GlueData`.  The overlap restriction
    13	maps are the algebra maps `A i -> B i j`.  Thus an application with specified restriction
    14	maps should install the corresponding `Algebra (A i) (B i j)` structures (for example via
    15	`r.toRingHom.toAlgebra`) before invoking the constructor.
    16	
    17	The only non-formal coherence assumptions are ring identities:
    18	
    19	* each transition `tau i j : B j i -> B i j` is the identity on the diagonal;
    20	* the triple transition `theta i j k` sends the right tensor inclusion to the left
    21	  inclusion followed by `tau i j`;
    22	* the three cyclic triple transitions compose to the identity.
    23	
    24	The constructor conjugates `Spec.map theta` by Mathlib's `pullbackSpecIso`.  The face and
    25	cocycle fields of `Scheme.GlueData` are then discharged from the displayed ring identities.
    26	-/
    27	
    28	set_option autoImplicit false

    30	universe u

    33	open scoped TensorProduct

    63	abbrev affineRestriction (i j : J) :

    65	  Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (A i) (B i j)))

   171	/-- A diagonal identity of overlap ring maps gives the diagonal transition identity. -/

   173	    (htau : ∀ i, tau i i = AlgHom.id R (B i i)) (i : J) :
   174	    affineTransition B tau i i = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of (B i i))) := by

   207	      t' := affineTripleTransition A B theta
